en.summary: Fatih Erbakan, leader of the Yeniden Refah Party who withdrew from the 2023 presidential race to support President Erdoğan, has announced his candidacy for an upcoming election.

en.summary: Remote work regulations published in the Official Gazette now formally permit hybrid work arrangements, with specific remote work days and hours to be determined in employment contracts.

en.summary: President Erdoğan attended a United Nations event alongside his wife Emine Erdoğan.

en.summary: Neşet Ertaş is being remembered on the 14th anniversary of his death through a special tribute organized by Istanbul's public transport authority.

en.summary: An investigation into Yahşihan Municipality has uncovered a massive fraud scheme in a district with a population of 40,000 residents.

en.title: They failed to see it again
en.summary: A person who injured 11 students with a rifle in Manisa had documented psychological issues, but this was apparently overlooked by authorities.

en.summary: A company that bid 32.5 million lira for a dam auction two years ago failed to pay and the sale was cancelled. The same company made another bid two years later.

stories.title: 'Bakan istifa edecek' demişti: Ali Tarakçı hakkında gözaltı kararı verildi

en.title: After claiming 'a minister will resign': Detention order issued for Ali Tarakçı
en.summary: A detention order was issued against Ali Tarakçı, who posted on social media that an important minister would resign on Friday.

stories.title: 'Bir bakan istifa edecek' demişti: Gazeteci Ali Tarakcı gözaltına alındı

en.title: 'A minister will resign,' journalist Ali Tarakcı detained
en.summary: Journalist Ali Tarakcı, who previously claimed an important minister would resign on Friday, is under investigation for spreading misleading information. A detention order was issued against him with authorization for a search of his residence and seizure of digital materials.

stories.title: Havada arızalanan eğitim uçağı tarlaya zorunlu iniş yaptı

en.title: Training aircraft with engine failure makes emergency landing in field
en.summary: A training aircraft that departed from Istanbul experienced engine trouble and was forced to land in a field in Tekirdağ's Süleymanpaşa district.

stories.title: Tekirdağ'da eğitim uçağı tarlaya zorunlu iniş yaptı: Pilotların durumu iyi

en.title: Training aircraft makes emergency landing in field in Tekirdağ: Pilots' condition is good
en.summary: A training aircraft experienced engine failure and made an emergency landing in a field in Tekirdağ's Süleymanpaşa district with no damage, and the two pilots taken to hospital for examination were in good condition.

stories.title: Meteoroloji'den hafta sonu için sağanak alarmı: Yağış birçok bölgede etkili olacak

en.title: Meteorology alert for weekend: Heavy rainfall expected in many regions
en.summary: Turkey's meteorology service forecasts heavy rainfall and thunderstorms across numerous parts of the country over the weekend. Winds in the Marmara east and northern Aegean regions are expected to reach speeds of up to 60 kilometers per hour.

stories.title: Microsoft Körfez'e 10 milyar dolar yatırıyor: Yapay zekâda para Orta Doğu'ya akıyor

en.title: Microsoft investing 10 billion dollars in the Gulf: Artificial intelligence money flows to Middle East
en.summary: Microsoft plans to invest over 10 billion dollars in cloud and artificial intelligence infrastructure across the Gulf region through 2030. The initiative covering UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Kuwait aims to accelerate the region's transformation into a post-oil technology center.

stories.title: Altında dengeler yeniden kuruluyor: Gram altını bekleyen 5 kritik gün

en.title: Gold balances being reset: 5 critical days ahead for gram gold
en.summary: Gold investors enter a new week at a critical level following sharp selling. Two major economic data releases from the United States could change price direction, while exchange rates remain influential for gram gold prices.

stories.title: Putin'den Ukrayna mesajı: Müzakereleri Rusya'nın çıkarları doğrultusunda başlatacağız

en.title: Putin's message on Ukraine: We will initiate negotiations in line with Russia's interests
en.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that decisions regarding resuming negotiations with Ukraine will be made according to Russia's interests. He also indicated Russia has no plans for conflict with Europe and welcomed discussions between the United States and China.

stories.title: Turgutlu'da 11 öğrencinin yaralandığı olayda 7 şüpheli tutuklandı

en.title: 7 suspects arrested in incident where 11 students were injured in Turgutlu
en.summary: Seven of ten suspects brought to court in connection with an incident in Turgutlu where eleven students were injured have been arrested. Three other suspects were released under judicial supervision.
